reviews.title: Buggy, doesn’t record movement
reviews.text: Does not record actual movement, e.g. someone entering through the door. Instead, it sends false movement alerts and shows altered footage, e.g. the recorded space at 7 pm appears brighter than it did at 5 pm. Scam. Even with a paid subscription, the app does not run smoothly, customer support is extremely difficult to reach, and data protection rules are unclear.
